checks: Authenticated report creation uses the real form/API/SQL and remains pending; injected user metadata does not grant reviewer access.
Original report, participant replies and team notes stay private; only the reviewed summary is shared with the respondent.
The first reviewer cannot take the appeal; a distinct authorized reviewer closes it and further appeal is disabled.
Own inbox contains only generic notices and marking read updates its count without disclosing case text.
Inbox errors are explicit and retry recovers.
Failed report submission preserves the user draft.
The full app layout, visible inbox access and forms fit 320/390/768/1440px and light/dark/Calm themes.
scope: Real AppRouter, auth context, React UI and HTTP client -> Express -> PostgreSQL/RLS in memory. Synthetic accounts/reviewer appointments only; no real Supabase or email/Google requests.
